l-e-h2-b06-40.material: Claim: Sports teach teamwork. Bhala umusho osekela lesi simangalo. Conditions: ① Uhlobene nokusebenzisana ② Uyisigameko esithile ③ Usebenzisa amagama angu-6 noma ngaphansi.
l-e-h2-b06-40.s.s1.r.a: Awunaso isigameko esithile, ngakho uyahluleka ku-②.
l-e-h2-b06-40.s.s1.r.b: Awusho lutho ngokusebenzisana, ngakho uyahluleka ku-①.
l-e-h2-b06-40.s.s1.explain: U-A dropped baton costs the team. wuhlobo lwesigameko se-relay esithile esihlobene nokusebenzisana futhi unamagama angu-6.
l-e-h2-b06-40.s.s2.model.0: Ukuwisa i-baton ku-relay kuyisibonelo esithile esihlobene nokusebenzisana futhi kunamagama angu-6, ngakho kuhlangabezana nazo zonke izimo ezintathu.
l-e-h2-b06-40.s.s2.model.1: Eminye ayisho lutho ngokusebenzisana, ayinaso isigameko, noma inamagama angu-8, ngakho lo musho uhambisana kangcono kakhulu.

l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa kuphela izinhlelo ezilandela zonke izimo.

l-e-h2-b07-04.title: Umusho wesaziso onenhlonipho ngaphandle kuka-if
l-e-h2-b07-04.goal: Ngesimo esinemibandela esizeni elinenhlonipho, linganisa zonke izimo eziphikisanayo, khetha ukuvumelana okungcono kakhulu, bese uchaza isizathu.
l-e-h2-b07-04.material: Bhala u-'Please call us if you need help' ngesiNgisi. Izimo: ① Ungasebenzisi u-if ② Ukwethule njengento engenzeka ③ Lisazisa elisemthethweni.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: Lethula into engenzeki kangako, ngakho alifanelani kahle ku-②.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: Lingumcabango wesikhathi esedlule, ngakho alifanelani no-②, okumayelana nesikhathi esizayo.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s1.explain: U-Should you need ... wethula ngokusemthethweni into engenzeka, ngaphandle kuka-if. U-Were you to usetshenziselwa izinto ezingenzeki.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: Uqala ngo-Should you need ngaphandle kuka-if futhi wethula ngokusemthethweni into engenzeka esikhathini esizayo, ngakho uhlangabezana nazo zontathu izimo.
l-e-h2-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: U-Were you to usetshenziselwa izinto ezingenzeki, ngakho u-Should you ukukhetha okulungile isicelo sosizo esivame ukwenzeka.
